decisions.reason: As a web-map add-on with its own launch page and visible early release effort, it benefits from sunk development and platform complementarity, so management is inclined to continue it despite its lower recent visibility.

Because this search plugin was less prominently presented and is more easily pruned as a niche extension, its withdrawal risk is higher, but its closeness to the core web-map offering still favors retention.
Its home-page launch visibility and clear mobile-usability role in the established GIS portfolio make management likely to justify continued support rather than reverse course now.
As the flagship platform line tied to the firm's announced strategic direction, it carries the strongest public commitment and accumulated investment, making withdrawal very unlikely.

This field data capture product sits close to the firm's integrated geospatial solutions and has dedicated presentation history, so escalation of commitment supports keeping it unless results clearly deteriorate.
